name: doc-preview-desktop
description: Electron desktop wrapper for 文档管理组件

scripts.install:deps: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web-component install
scripts.prepare:server:env: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src='server/.env'; const dst='server/runtime.env'; if(fs.existsSync(src)){ fs.copyFileSync(src,dst); console.log('copied',src,'->',dst);} else { console.log('skip runtime env copy, server/.env not found'); }"
scripts.prepare:server: npm --prefix server install --omit=dev && npm run prepare:server:env
scripts.prepare:server:kylin: npm run clean:server:modules && npm --prefix server ci --omit=dev && npm run prepare:server:env && npm run prepare:backend:runtime:kylin
scripts.prepare:backend:runtime:kylin: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); if(process.platform!=='linux'){ console.log('skip backend runtime copy on non-linux'); process.exit(0);} const src=process.execPath; const dst=path.join('electron','runtime','linux-x64','node'); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dst),{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src,dst); fs.chmodSync(dst,0o755); console.log('bundled backend runtime', src, '->', dst);"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "npm --prefix web-component run dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:5173 && node electron/run-dev.cjs"
scripts.desktop:verify:win: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:server && electron-builder --win dir -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.verify:server:node-abi: node -e "require('./server/node_modules/better-sqlite3'); console.log('better-sqlite3 node abi check passed');"
scripts.desktop:verify:kylin: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:server:kylin && npm run verify:server:node-abi && electron-builder --linux dir
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:server && electron-builder
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:server && electron-builder --win nsis -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.desktop:pack:win:zip: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:server && electron-builder --win zip -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.desktop:pack:kylin: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:server:kylin && npm run verify:server:node-abi && electron-builder --linux deb AppImage
scripts.desktop:pack:kylin:deb: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:server:kylin && npm run verify:server:node-abi && electron-builder --linux deb
scripts.desktop:pack:kylin:appimage: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:server:kylin && npm run verify:server:node-abi && electron-builder --linux AppImage
